paragraphs: Ulla bar Yishmael, Ḥelek 92a; Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot, HaMaddir, halakhah 3. In R. Elazar's name, beginning of Ma'aserot 3. R. Zeira. Ulla bar Yishmael in R. Elazar's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Ḥagigah 1, halakhah 4. R. Zeira dreamed that Ulla bar Yishmael was fed fatty meat, a sign that Zeira would receive a sound explanation from Ulla, Ma'aser Sheni 2:3:4 (source locator 2:7). In R. Yoḥanan's name, beginning of Demai; end of 1, R. Yonah says he rightly objects. R. Yonah in R. Elazar's name, beginning of Kilayim 9. In R. Yitzḥak's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Nedarim 4, halakhah 2.
